text: Every module specification of this family is issued as Draft, because no approval of the new version is recorded.
why: The source status is In review and D-RCV-60 runs without an approval step (AGENTS.md rule 9).
read: 'Status In review' becomes 'Draft', and the Document control adds a Status note with the gap and this assumption.
impact: None on content; the approval state is visible.

text: lake_copy_watermark stays with P1 as the watermark of the last published reporting projection; the lake extract is not built.
why: The data lake is removed (ADR-018; DP-17) while the Ownership Map keeps the table with P1.
read: DP-17 in T0.3 of P1 and the T3 note of P1; no interface to a lake appears in T5.1 or T5.2.
impact: P9 reads events; no outbound extract.

text: The platform tables of TSD P2 T3.1 are built once in the shared libraries, and efs_ledger_outcome stays with P1.
why: The Ownership Map Tables sheet has no per-service row for an outbox, an inbox, an idempotency key or a feature flag, and it places efs_ledger_outcome with P1.
read: T3 note of P2; T0.2 lists the three P2 business tables.
impact: Platform stories own the library tables; P2 owns the outbound behaviour.

text: The rule package registry is P7's, and P3 and P4 read it through the P7 contract.
why: Architecture v5 slide 41 gives the DMN model registry to rwb-decision and the Ownership Map gives the four tables to P7, while two module specifications still claim them.
read: T3 note of P3 and P4; T2 note of P3 and P4; T5.2.2 lists the P7 contract.
applied_in: TSD P3 v4 and TSD P4 v4, T0.2, T2, T3, T5.2
impact: Embedded Drools evaluation stays in the owning service (DP-04).

text: payment_match_rule becomes the PAYMENT_MATCH rule package of rwb-decision; P8 keeps the proceeds rows.
why: The Ownership Map has no row for the table and ADR-017 puts every rule in the registry.
impact: P8 holds no rule table; the package is promoted by RW-COE.

text: S1 owns the valuations and the route decision in rwb_valuation, and valuation_ext stays with P1.
why: The Ownership Map Endpoints sheet gives S1 the valuation paths and Architecture v5 gives it the valuations, while the Tables sheet has no S1 row.
read: T3 note of S1; T5.2.1 lists both operations.
impact: A valuation table is created in rwb_valuation; P1 keeps the SVAF extension table.

text: An event with no catalogue number is named in T5.3 and cited in this assumption; the missing number and the missing AsyncAPI operation are not invented.
why: The Arch v5 catalogue numbers 30 rows and leaves eleven as plus rows, and four events have no AsyncAPI operation.
read: T5.3 footnote of the affected files; T5.2.1 of P9.
applied_in: T5.2.1 and T5.3 of the affected files
impact: Consumers can build against the named message; numbering follows in the next catalogue version.

text: Where the Arch v5 contract slides and the published OpenAPI files differ, the published file is the contract cited in T5.2.
why: The consumer's fake is generated from the published artefact (ADR-020), and the difference is recorded as a gap rather than resolved by invention.
read: T5.2 intro and the appendix T-A note of every file.
applied_in: T5.2 and Appendix T-A of all 20 files
impact: The build follows the published files; the architecture pack needs a correction.

text: The Build squad row keeps the version 5 wording until the design authority assigns a squad per service.
why: No source names a squad per service and Template and Rules R5.3 keeps the owner a suggestion.
read: Document control Build squad row, with the gap and this assumption cited in the row.
